params._comment: R27 (§17.3 fork (a)): the Cell's play loop over the duck's map vocabulary -- the node is the map EPM's winner (pi_cell_size 0), the value field is the place TLE, the climb is the bearing to the most novel reachable node (wander_stall_ticks 0: the Cell's A2, so the climb engages). Its bearing sets the adapter's heading reference (sense slot 10); the heading prior turns the body. The loop the Cell dropped is the loop the duck wants: coverage is its goal.

description: R41 (W3 a place is a STOP: the map learns only while standing, a view is pose + gaze, the look is driven by the map's own novelty (a quiet round ends the stop)), from a1v2_r40_w2_scan.json: The walk-stop-look line's map (playroom plan §12.2, W3): the map EPM's insertion, adaptation and pruning are on only at stops; the place vector gains the head yaw so each bearing at a stop is its own view; at a stop the head steps 0, +0.6, -0.6 rad, holding each at least 1 s and up to 4 s while the map calls the view novel; a full round with nothing novel ends the stop early, so the stop's length is the map's. Judged on stop length vs novelty (contingency), saccades and nodes per stop, switch/min, cells, walls, and the moved-object (d).
